lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance blobs arranged in a grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits, characterized by approximately five distinct vertical columns with four to five blobs per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal planes of blob placement, creating a nodal appearance across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a high-luminance dorsal edge to a lower-luminance ventral shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible in the ventral-posterior region of the pectoral fin.
